{
  "name": "loss_margin_rankgap_advantage_exp",
  "intuition": "Use a margin ranking loss that incorporates the rank gap of advantages between winning and losing sequences, applying an exponential link to penalize larger negative ranking gaps more strongly; aggregates via a weighted mean with softmax-based weight emphasizing larger rank gaps.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nrank_gap = rank_gap(advantage_w, advantage_l)  # custom rank gap operator\nmargin = margin_hyperparam\nexp_term = exp(-margin * rank_gap)\nloss_unweighted = relu(margin - adv_gap) * exp_term\nweights = softmax(rank_gap * weight_scale)\nloss = mean(weights * loss_unweighted)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_rankgap",
    "link_family": "exponential",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean_softmax",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "relu",
    "exp",
    "softmax",

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",

      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))\n    weight_scale = float(extra.get('weight_scale', 5.0))\n\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    # Compute rank gap as a smoothed estimate or proxy; fallback rank_gap operator expects 1D tensors\n    rank_gaps = ops.rank_gap(adv_w, adv_l)\n\n    margin_diff = ops.sub(margin, adv_gap)\n    relu_term = ops.maximum(margin_diff, ops.zeros_like(margin_diff))\n    exp_term = ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(margin, rank_gaps)))\n    loss_unweighted = ops.mul(relu_term, exp_term)\n\n    # Compute weights via softmax on scaled rank gaps, ensure shape compatibility\n    rank_weights = ops.softmax(ops.mul(rank_gaps, weight_scale))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_unweighted = ops.mul(loss_unweighted, weight)\n        rank_weights = ops.mul(rank_weights, weight)\n\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_unweighted, rank_weights)\n    loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)\n    return loss"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_exp_advantage_sigmoid_gap",
  "intuition": "Leverages the exponential of the advantage difference as an importance weight to focus more on pairs with higher advantage imbalance, transforming the score difference via a sigmoid to smoothly enforce preference while aggregating losses with weighted sum instead of mean for emphasis.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nweighting = exp(clamp(adv_diff, -5, 5))\nscore_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nsigmoid_term = sigmoid(score_diff)\npair_loss = -log(sigmoid_term)\nweighted_loss = pair_loss * weighting * weight\nloss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weighting * weight)",

  },

  ],

    "expects": [

    ],

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    adv_diff = ops.clamp(ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l), -5.0, 5.0)\n    weighting = ops.exp(adv_diff)\n    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    sig_term = ops.sigmoid(score_diff)\n    # To avoid log(0), clamp sigmoid output minimum\n    sig_term_clamped = ops.clamp(sig_term, 1e-7, 1.0)\n    pair_loss = ops.neg(ops.log(sig_term_clamped))\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(pair_loss, ops.mul(weighting, weight))\n    total_weight = ops.sum(ops.mul(weighting, weight)) + 1e-7\n    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), total_weight)\n    return loss"
}

  "name": "loss_contrastive_ranked_softplus_000_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a contrastive softplus loss that explicitly weights the hinge by the sign and magnitude of the advantage gap, switching from margin ranking/logsigmoid to softplus and incorporating a monotonic weighting that encourages larger advantage gaps to drive stronger gradient signals.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\nx = (batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']) * ops.sign(adv_gap)\nweight = ops.relu(adv_gap)\nloss_terms = ops.softplus(-x) * weight\nloss = loss_terms.mean()",

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    sign_adv = ops.sign(adv_gap)\n    relu_adv = ops.relu(adv_gap)\n    x = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), sign_adv)\n    loss_terms = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(x)), relu_adv)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_terms = loss_terms * weight\n    return loss_terms.mean()"
}

  "name": "loss_sigmoid_advantage_hinge",

    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 5.0))\n    margin = alpha * advantage_gap\n    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    relu_term = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin, score_diff))\n    loss_raw = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(beta, relu_term))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_raw = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss_raw)"

    # Combine advantages weighted towards the parent with higher advantage
    adv_weight = ops.sigmoid(ops.add(advantage_w, advantage_l))

    loss = base_loss - bias
    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight
    return loss.mean()",

{
  "name": "combined_pairwise_logsigmoid_loss",
  "intuition": "Simplified and stabilized the combined loss by clamping the scaled log_prob difference before applying logsigmoid, preventing numerical instability. Weighted loss by batch['weight'] when provided, preserving expected weighting. Uses only required keys from batch for pairwise mode.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = lpw - lpl\nscale0 = extra['hyperparams_parent0'].get('scale', 1.0)\nscale1 = extra['hyperparams_parent1'].get('scale', 1.0)\nscale = max(scale0, scale1)\nx = clamp(diff * scale, -20, 20)\nloss = -logsigmoid(x)\nif weight: loss *= weight\nreturn mean(loss)",

  },
